apps.name: FindYourself
apps.description: Drop into a random Street View location anywhere in the world and guess where you are on the map. Requires a Google Maps API key.

apps.name: Sudofall
apps.description: A mix between Tetris and Sudoku — drop numbers into the grid, clear rows and 3x3 boxes to score points.

apps.name: Game Hub
apps.description: Central hub for player profiles and game statistics. Tracks sessions, scores and leaderboards across all games.

apps.name: Stonehold
apps.description: A map, four enemy camps in the corners and no hold yet: choose where to settle, build, and survive as long as you can while all four keep growing — alone, or racing up to three other holds in the same room.

apps.name: Tower Defense
apps.description: Defend the tower in the middle. Waves close in from every side and the tower fires back — hold out as long as you can.
